question: Should `openclaw health` expose a stable read-scoped `runtimeConfig` drift diagnostic for restart-pending model, provider, and authentication changes, or should this information remain an admin-only/internal diagnostic?
rationale: The patch is more than a local bug repair: it adds a new gateway health response shape and makes restart-pending configuration state visible to ordinary operator-read clients. Current code and adjacent merged health work establish the plumbing pattern, but they do not establish this payload as a supported product contract.

options.title: Adopt a read-scoped diagnostic
options.body: Keep the redacted state, model labels, and drift paths for ordinary health callers, with sensitive fingerprints and read errors restricted to admin scope.

options.title: Make it admin-only
options.body: Expose the diagnostic only to `operator.admin` callers if restart-pending configuration details should not become part of ordinary health output.

options.title: Defer to managed-config work
options.body: Pause this PR and define convergence reporting together with the externally managed configuration direction.

recommendation.title: Adopt a read-scoped diagnostic
recommendation.body: Keep the redacted state, model labels, and drift paths for ordinary health callers, with sensitive fingerprints and read errors restricted to admin scope.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked configuration-ownership proposal is the clearest active product discussion covering the intended operator contract.
